annotations.title: Remove an allow or block entry

description: Use this when an address or domain should leave an allow or block list. Requires auth. Deletes that one entry. Inputs: direction (required; send, receive, or reply), type (required; allow or block), entry (required; email or domain), inbox_id (optional; omit for the account-wide list). Returns the list entry with deleted true. Fails with 400 invalid_list, 400 invalid_entry, 404 list_entry_not_found, or inbox_not_found. The per-inbox task allowlist is unchanged.

entry.description: Email address or domain to remove.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email. Omit for the account-wide list.

name: cooper_delete_list_entry

outputSchema.description: The list entry, with deleted true.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

deleted.description: True when the object was deleted.

entry.description: The email address or domain on the list.

inbox_id.description: Inbox the entry applies to, or null for the whole account.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

reason.description: Optional note stored with the entry.

title: Remove an allow or block entry
